description: Generate a QR code image that opens the short link. The image is returned as an image block. Read-only: it does not change the link.

id.description: Link id (UUID) as returned by shorten_url, shorten_urls or list_links.

logo.description: Put the LinkBit logo in the center of the code.

print.description: Use the print-oriented variant of the code.

name: get_qr
